content: Womu ɡeniwɑ Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ kuɑ sɑnɑm mɛ u nùn wɔrɑ sɑɑ win yibɛrɛbɑn nɔmɑn di, n mɑm nɛɛre Sɔɔlu.
